text:
mike: Heads-up: console shows p99 spike for /v1/generate in us-central at 09:31 but p50/p95 steady. anyone seen this pattern?

anya: I pulled split-by-route. route=short-prompt has p99=1.9s but n=7 that minute. web clients are fine.

jamal: sounds like a low-sample artifact from rollups. we use tdigest for rollups by default. small bursts can push extreme percentiles.

siobhan: quick fix idea: show samplecount inline next to each percentile and display a yellow "low-samples" pill when n<50. also offer an "exact" button to fetch raw-agg for the minute.

mike: +1. also overlay minute-aligned rollout/route weights on the sparkline so fallback events are visible without flipping panels.

jamal: backend already exposes /raw-agg used by SRE playbooks. I'll add a perf guard for large spans and wire an exact toggle on the card.

anya: UX: badge text like "p99 1900ms (n=7) ⚠ low samples" and a small "exact" link. for alerts, include samplecount in the payload and tag alerts as "low-sample-suspect" when n<30.

siobhan: I'll run a quick tdigest vs raw sim for n in [5,10,20,50] and recommend a cutoff. will post numbers EOD.

console-bot: created ticket CON-7001 "Latency card: inline samplecount, low-sample advisory, exact-minute aggregate toggle, weight overlay" assigned to eng-platform.

mike: thanks. action items: jamal frontend wiring, siobhan sims, anya alert payload change. demo at next sync.
